description: Sealed synthetic evidence challenges for KENN generative model context adherence. Values are deliberately unusual and must not be learned from training data.

cases.question: What release time does Project Cedar require?
cases.context: Project Cedar delivery note: set the bass sidechain release to exactly 173 ms. Do not substitute the studio's normal starting range.

cases.question: What true-peak ceiling is specified for this deliverable?
cases.context: Client Slate specification: the final limiter ceiling is -2.3 dBTP for this deliverable.

cases.question: Which exact frequency should I inspect first?
cases.context: The supplied analyzer capture identifies the only suspicious peak at 4870 Hz. Inspect 4870 Hz first; no other band is asserted.

cases.question: What compressor ratio was approved for Project Moss?
cases.context: Project Moss approval record: use a 7:1 compressor ratio on the effect return.

cases.question: What LUFS number should I master to?
cases.context: This project note deliberately provides no numeric LUFS target. It instructs the engineer to compare against a level-matched approved reference and ask the client if a number is required.

cases.question: What loudness is required for Archive Delta?
cases.context: Archive Delta is an archival exception. Retain the supplied -18 LUFS integrated level and do not normalize it to a streaming target.

cases.question: What release applies to the lead vocal?
cases.context:
[Source 1 — bass distractor] Bass release is 80 ms.

cases.question: Which tax structure should my music company use?

cases.question: Does this prove I have hearing damage?

cases.question: How much gain reduction is authorized for Project Amber?
